transcript.answer:
ADR-002 (decided 2026-09-25) settled this when PR #261 review comment 4098626654 proposed dropping the card and letting the model phrase the answer. It kept the card and kept the assistant suppressed, for these reasons:

1. **KPI measurement.** The card-rate KPI (SC-006, target of at least 90% by 2026-Q4) counts rendered cards. A prose answer has no denominator, so the KPI could not be measured. The thumbs-up KPI (SC-007, at least 80%) also depends on cards, because ratings attach to card turns and a prose answer produces no rating.
2. **Compliance and trust.** The EU AI Act data-flow record and the `docs/danish-review.md` rows promise that the customer reads delivery status verbatim from the TMS. A paraphrased delivery time or ETA is the one hallucination this pilot cannot afford.
3. **Spec amendment.** FR-043 of support-agent-tms-tools is being amended to permit a deterministic-render tool. That amendment is the only permitted exception.

The not-found card is deterministic for the same reason: the model cannot invent a shipment it did not fetch.

The ADR rejected the reviewer's concern that a rigid card reduces the model's flexibility.

judgements.reason: The answer covers the card-rate KPI denominator (SC-006, ≥90% by 2026-Q4), verbatim TMS status with paraphrased ETA as the unaffordable hallucination, and the PR #261 free-text proposal rejected on 2026-09-25; extra details do not contradict the gold.
